title: Is Google Business Profile enough for AI visibility?

facts.fact: Cheers' Market Baseline reports that business websites supplied 68.1% of pooled AI citations in the 28 days ending September 2, 2026.
facts.quote: Business websites 68.1% Pooled share of citations

facts.fact: Cheers' Market Baseline reports that Google surfaces supplied 3.3% of pooled AI citations in the 28 days ending September 2, 2026.
facts.quote: Google surfaces 3.3% Pooled share of citations

facts.fact: The Cheers Market Baseline citation figures cover 49,677 local-intent runs and 356,019 citations across 100 metros and four engines over 28 days ending September 2, 2026.
facts.quote: Cheers Market Baseline, 28 days ending September 2, 2026; 100 metros, four engines, 49,677 runs, 356,019 citations, aggregate only

facts.fact: Cheers states the Market Baseline citation figures were corrected on September 23, 2026.
facts.quote: aggregate only (corrected September 23, 2026)

facts.fact: Google Search Central guidance telling local businesses to keep Business Profile information current for AI search was updated July 10, 2026, per the page.
facts.quote: That guidance was updated July 10, 2026.

facts.fact: Google states that local results are mainly based on relevance, distance, and prominence, and that review count and rating can factor into local ranking.
facts.quote: Google says local results are mainly based on relevance, distance, and prominence.

facts.fact: The article was published May 30, 2026, updated September 2, 2026, and last verified September 2, 2026.
facts.quote: Published May 30, 2026 Updated September 2, 2026

facts.fact: Google's service-area guidance says service areas should be set by city, postal code, or another area type, not by a radius.
facts.value: city, postal code, or other area type (not radius)
facts.quote: with service areas set by city, postal code, or another area type, not by a radius.

facts.fact: Google's guidelines for chains say locations that provide the same service should generally maintain consistent names and categories.
facts.quote: Google's guidelines for chains say locations that provide the same service should generally maintain consistent names and categories.

facts.fact: Google's profile guidelines prohibit low-quality or irrelevant content in Business Profile descriptions.
facts.quote: they prohibit low-quality or irrelevant content.

facts.fact: According to OpenAI's ChatGPT search documentation as cited in the article, ChatGPT can search the web and provide answers with links to relevant web sources.
facts.quote: ChatGPT can search the web and provide answers with links to relevant web sources.

facts.fact: Google explains that Business Profile information can come from business owners, publicly available web content, licensed third-party data, user contributions, reviews, and photos.
facts.quote: Google also explains that Business Profile information can come from business owners, publicly available web content, licensed third-party data, user contributions, reviews, photos

facts.fact: The article recommends reading a profile's review sample from the last 60 to 90 days when auditing a Google Business Profile.
facts.quote: read a review sample from the last 60 to 90 days

facts.fact: The article states that Google AI Mode can use query fan-out to inspect several pieces of evidence behind one local question.
facts.quote: Google AI Mode can use query fan-out to inspect several pieces of evidence behind one local question.

facts.fact: The Google Search Central guide 'AI features and your website' is dated July 2026 on the page.
facts.quote: [AI features and your website](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide), Google Search Central, July 2026.

facts.fact: The Cheers Research 'AI Visibility Statistics' page is dated September 2026.
facts.quote: [AI Visibility Statistics](https://cheers.tech/research/ai-visibility-statistics), Cheers Research, September 2026.

facts.fact: The Cheers Research 'Research methodology' page is dated September 2026.
facts.quote: [Research methodology](https://cheers.tech/research/methodology), Cheers Research, September 2026.

facts.fact: The page's listed sources were checked on September 2, 2026.
facts.quote: Checked September 2, 2026.

facts.fact: A local-visibility branch is marked supported only when the Google Business Profile, page, reviews, citations, schema, and third-party mentions all agree.
facts.quote: If GBP, page, reviews, citations, schema, and third-party mentions agree, mark the branch as supported.

facts.fact: If the answer depends only on Google Business Profile, the branch is considered under-supported.
facts.quote: If the answer depends only on Google Business Profile, the branch is under-supported.

facts.fact: When one artifact disagrees with the others, the page recommends assigning that artifact to an owner before publishing more content.
facts.quote: If one artifact disagrees, assign that artifact to an owner before publishing more content.

facts.fact: Google Business Profile anchors category, address or service area, hours, phone, services, photos, and reviews for Google surfaces, but is not sufficient alone.
facts.quote: GBP anchors category, address or service area, hours, phone, services, photos, and reviews for Google surfaces. It is not enough alone.
